edges.decisive_discriminant: Evaluation measures harm after it has occurred, and harm occurs when asymptomatic people are labelled as possibly having a disease but further investigation cannot be carried out, which is what mailing 60 000 invitations into a 900-procedure pathway would produce.
excluded_contexts: Do not use where the shortfall in the confirmatory pathway is known before the invitations are issued.
edges.plausible_error: A candidate who selects the option carrying a recognised programme criterion does not ask whether that criterion addresses the shortfall described.
